title: Darnold still on track to face 49ers, but Seahawks holding off on final call

sources.name: ESPN NFL
sources.title: Darnold still on track to face 49ers, but Seahawks holding off on final call
sources.description: The Seahawks still plan to start Sam Darnold against the 49ers but will wait to see how the QB looks in practice Wednesday before making a final call.
